posts.preview: Adopted by the First Congress of SWAPO in an Independent Namibia, 6–12 December 1991, Windhoek, Republic of Namibia.
To achieve the aims and objectives of SWAPO, as stipulated in the Party Constitution, all Party organs, wings and affiliated bodies are charged with the following responsibilities:
(c) To promote progressive labour relations and improve the living and working conditions of workers.

(d) To defend workers’ democratic rights to organise themselves to articulate and advance their interests, and to collectively withdraw their labour when confronted with unjust practices by employers.
